philosophy: Premium healthcare branding + modern wellness + high-end SaaS + editorial typography + human photography. 'Never make the patient operate the clinic's internal system.' Do not over-design. Do not use excessive animations, gradients, or glassmorphism. White space intelligently used.

typography.guidelines: Avoid Inter, Roboto, and Space Grotesk. Use Spectral for marketing headings (e.g., Hero, Section titles) to create a premium editorial feel. Use Manrope for admin dashboards to maximize data clarity. Use DM Sans for all body text. Apply tracking-tight to headings and leading-relaxed to body text.

visual_enhancers.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. For marketing, p-8, py-16, py-24. For admin, p-4, p-6, gap-4, gap-6.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Cards: rounded-xl (12px). Buttons: rounded-lg. Inputs: rounded-md. Admin tables: rounded-md. Avoid excessive pill shapes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle and grounded. Marketing cards: shadow-sm to shadow-md. Floating nav: shadow-sm. Admin: borders preferred over shadows, shadow-sm for active widgets.
visual_enhancers.motion: Subtle only. Hover: -translate-y-0.5. Micro-interactions on buttons. NO excessive parallax or bouncy scroll animations.
visual_enhancers.transparency: DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds under text or in headers over images. Use solid or heavily blurred (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80) surfaces.

component_specs.buttons: Primary: Solid #1B362F text-white. Secondary: Solid #C87961 text-white. Tertiary/Outline: border-border text-text_main.
component_specs.cards: White surface, 1px border-border, subtle padding (p-6 or p-8).
component_specs.badges: Small, rounded-full, px-2.5 py-0.5, text-xs font-semibold.
component_specs.tables: Admin tables must be compact but readable, text-sm, left-aligned, sticky headers if scrollable.
component_specs.modals_drawers: Use right-side Drawers for Admin appointment details. Use Modals for confirmations.
component_specs.booking_wizard: Step-based logic. Show clear progress. Mobile-first grid for time slots.
component_specs.mobile_action_bar: Sticky fixed bottom bar for mobile. h-16, z-50. 3 equal tabs: Call, WhatsApp, Book.

layouts.marketing: Asymmetric bento grids for features, heavy reliance on negative space, wide containers (max-w-7xl).
layouts.admin: Classic high-density SaaS layout. Fixed left sidebar (w-64), top header (h-16), scrollable main content area with max-w-full.

images.description: Doctor examining leg. Professional, clinical yet human.
Cream armchairs against wood slatted wall. Premium feel.

accessibility.focus: Visible focus states on all interactive elements (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. No light gray text on white backgrounds.
accessibility.semantics: Use semantic HTML tags (nav, main, section, article, header, footer).

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-appointment-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Write React components using JSX syntax but in .js extensions.
Do not use placeholder image domains. ONLY use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs or UI icons.
Build the public site and admin dashboard within a unified router (e.g., React Router) with clear path separation (/ for marketing, /admin for dashboard).
Ensure mobile responsiveness is prioritized. The booking flow must be usable with one hand.
Admin capacity views should clearly show '09:00-10:00 18/20 booked FULL'.
Do not invent fake logos; use text-based branding 'Kaushalya Advanced Physio' in the Spectral font if a logo image is unavailable.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their default Vercel-like appearance to match the Organic & Earthy aesthetic.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds under text or in dropdowns.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, etc. for icons. Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Every interaction needs micro-animations (excluding generic transition:all). Use Sonner for toasts.
